items.rationale: Glazing peril 2.1(e) not stated as agreed; glazing excluded under 2.6.4 and 3.5(a)/(b).
Preparatory glazing work, excluded under 3.5(b) as the optional glazing peril is not agreed.
Fitting of glazing element is glazing work, excluded under 3.5(b).
Removal and disposal of the broken element is glazing work (3.5(b)); 5.2.1 does not extend to remains of non-covered items.

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table
items.rationale: Sudden accidental damage under 2.6.1/2.6.2 to movable household property; necessary repair cost under 7.1.1(b) at a fair market price.

items.description: Touch-up of pre-existing scratches on second cabinet
items.rationale: Pre-existing condition on an unaffected item, excluded under 3.6(a)/(b) and 7.1.9.
One attendance per undertaking is payable in full under 7.1.12 since covered table repair was done; reference shows a low price level (below 28).
Return visit by the same undertaking is not separately indemnified under 7.1.12 without prior insurer agreement.
General administrative charge is the undertaking's own business outlay, excluded under 7.1.8(b).
